subject: Eden Chang
intro: Hi, I'm Eden, a technical product manager.
I got my start in industrial design, metalwork and exhibition planning.
My work starts with everyday problems and turns them into product plans.

experience.name: Notice the friction
experience.description: Repeated workarounds and scattered information make me curious. I look at who needs help and where the task gets difficult.

experience.name: Make the plan clear
experience.description: I clarify scope, permissions and exceptions, then use workflows and UML to make the plan easier to discuss.

experience.name: Try the idea
experience.description: Prototypes help me spot gaps and revisit the scope. System integration and AWS experience inform the practical side.

strengths.name: Problem framing
strengths.description: Sort through scattered requirements to clarify what needs solving.

strengths.name: Empathy
strengths.description: Understand what people need before deciding what to build.

strengths.name: Cross-functional communication
strengths.description: Help users, business and engineering agree on a plan.

strengths.name: Structured thinking
strengths.description: Work out the workflows, priorities and next steps behind an idea.
